meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把想法或现成网页做成能点击跳转、带演讲备注的演示幻灯片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在会议或路演上展示一份能交互跳转、自带备注的演示稿。
copy.tagline_en: Build a clickable, branching slide deck with speaker notes from an idea or page.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need an interactive deck that branches and shows speaker notes.

howto.what: 让它把内容写成 HyperFrames 幻灯片：产出可直接播放的演示 deck（分页、逐段揭示、热点分支、演讲者备注），也能把现有网页转成 deck，而非渲染成 MP4。
howto.when: 当你明确要求幻灯片或类似演示，或想把现有网页转成 deck 时触发；请求不明确时它会先确认是否做成幻灯片再动手。

say.text: 把这页网页转成一个可播放的幻灯片 deck
say.note: 它会保留原页面设计与交互，重排为分页导航。

say.text: 做一份带演讲者备注和热点分支的演示 deck
给这页幻灯片加上热点，点了跳到分支内容
say.note: 热点绑定到 slideSequences 里的分支序列。

howto.what_en: It authors a HyperFrames slideshow: a runnable deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, hotspot branching and presenter notes, and it can convert an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for a slideshow or similar presentation form, or to convert an existing page into a deck. If unclear, it confirms before building.

say_en.text: Turn this page into a playable slideshow deck
say_en.note: It keeps the source design and interactions, re-hosted as slides.

say_en.text: Build a deck with speaker notes and hotspot branches
say_en.note: Output opens with hyperframes present; no MP4 is rendered.

say_en.text: Add hotspots that jump to branch slides
